title: Earthy Mushroom Stir Fry
description: A savory and earthy stir fry made with sautéed mushrooms and served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, and thyme. Stir to combine.
Continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the mushrooms over steamed vegetables.
